{{unknown name}} [[File:Ferrara henchmen.png|thumb|250px|Dr. Ferrara's henchmen]] '''Dr. Ferrara's henchmen''' are two [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW057|The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!]]''. They were both hired by [[Dr. Ferrara]] to form "Team {{p|Vanillite}}", and served as antagonists of the episode. They were driving a truck to the [[Cold Storage]] in order to tell Dr. Ferrara about their task in collecting goods from all over the Unova region. When {{OBP|Linda|BW057}} went inside the Cold Storage to investigate the activity, she was caught by Dr. Ferrara and his henchmen. Linda battled the henchmen with her {{p|Timburr}} but it got frozen when it was about to use {{m|Focus Punch}}. Following her loss, Linda was captured and then tied up by the henchmen's boss. Dr. Ferrara revealed that the minions and him would go around stealing goods, take over Unova and attempt to befriend the {{type|Ice}}, mostly Vanillite, using frozen food. Before they could begin, [[Charles]] arrived with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} and managed to save Linda. However, Dr. Ferrara and his henchmen were about to get away until Charles in his Accelguard alter ego sped up to them and blocked their way with his motorcycle. While Accelguard took on Dr. Ferrara when he became Cryogonal Man, Ash and Linda handled the two henchmen. They simultaneously defeated the two men and [[Officer Jenny]] arrived to arrest them and Dr. Ferrara. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dr. Ferrara's henchmen |pkmn=Vanillite (×2) |type1=Ice |img=Ferrara henchmen Vanillite.png |cap=Cryogonal Man's henchmen's Vanillite |epnum=BW057 |epname=The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue! |vajp=Chinami Nishimura |vaen=Emily Jenness |desc=Dr. Ferrara's henchmen sent out {{p|Vanillite}} when {{OBP|Linda|BW057}} was caught in the [[Cold Storage]], discovering what was going on. When her {{p|Timburr}} battled one of the Vanillite, the Vanillite retaliated by using Blizzard to freeze Timburr's {{m|Focus Punch}}. Later, when the henchmen were trying to run away from the Cold Storage, both Vanillite battled with Timburr and [[Ash's Pikachu]] and were defeated.
